preconditions.description: The number of nodes N is at least 1.
The input contains exactly N-1 edges.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: All edge endpoints are valid node indices between 1 and N.
The edges form a valid tree structure (connected and acyclic) with N nodes.

postconditions.description: The output integer equals the maximum number of connected components achievable by applying the operation any number of times.

postconditions.expression: max_components == sum(1 for u in range(1, N + 1) if is_leaf(u, adj))
postconditions.description: The maximum number of components is equal to the count of leaf nodes in the original tree, as each leaf can be targeted to split the tree optimally, and the optimal strategy yields a component count equal to the number of leaves.
